name: Jade Mountain
insider_take: This architectural marvel literally brings the Caribbean into your room - with no fourth wall, your sanctuary opens directly to the Pitons and endless ocean views.
whats_special: Each "sanctum" suite features an infinity pool and no fourth wall, creating an unparalleled open-air experience. The resort sits on a 600-acre rainforest estate with direct views of UNESCO World Heritage Pitons - two volcanic peaks rising dramatically from the sea. Jade Mountain is adults-only and completely TV and phone-free, designed for ultimate digital detox luxury.
pro_tip: Book a Sky Jacuzzi suite for the most dramatic Pitons views, and time your arrival for late afternoon to catch the legendary Caribbean sunset from your infinity pool.
dont_miss: The nearby Sulphur Springs - the world's only drive-in volcano where you can take therapeutic mud baths. Also explore the historic Soufrière town, where Napoleon's Josephine was born, and visit the Diamond Botanical Gardens with its rainbow-colored waterfall created by volcanic minerals.
pros: Spectacular open-air suites with breathtaking Piton mountain views
Unique architectural design with missing fourth walls for seamless indoor-outdoor living
Private infinity pools in every suite overlooking the Caribbean Sea
World-class spa and wellness facilities in stunning natural setting
